findings.reason: The Definition uses real analytic for torus functions and parametrisations without defining it or citing an exact supplier. Add def-real-analytic-germ-in-several-variables and state its relevant content: each real component is locally an absolutely convergent real power series, with the corresponding holomorphic complexification.

The Statement omits 2π-periodicity, so its Fourier representation and decay claims fail for general holomorphic g. Add periodicity, state a phase-only case explicitly or restrict the joint-parameter case to h>0, and replace full-domain uniform action/parameter derivative convergence with locally uniform convergence or estimates on smaller domains.

The proof shifts g rather than the Fourier integrand g(z)e^{-ikz}; its δ-to-σ substitutions in steps 2.1, 3.1 and 5.1 are reversed. The shell-count argument contradicts itself, the second-derivative derivation is insufficient, and step 4.1 needs a local uniform integral argument for coefficient holomorphy.

Case (G) uses h=0 output norms for a family holomorphic only at each real label, but O₀ is empty and the family norm convention is not stated. Give the bounds explicitly as suprema over real labels of the phase-space norms.

The Statement does not require P to be 2π-periodic in the angles, although R=T_KQ, the contour estimates, and the Fourier truncation bounds require it. Add the periodicity hypothesis; the actual one-step consumers supply it.

The approved E28 design includes positive Lebesgue measure for the union of surviving tori in phase space. The current theorem proves positive measure only for the frequency-label set; restore the phase-space claim with a complete joint lower-Lipschitz and measure argument. Positive label measure alone does not imply positive phase-space measure.

F is specified only on the 2r₀ tube around K, but H is stated on all of U∩Rⁿ; state the actual Hamiltonian domain or assume an extension. Also define and use the physical lift consistently: the parameter theorem’s Ψ∞ is in translated action coordinates, while the physical map includes b(χ∞(ν)) (or an explicitly defined total correction about b(ν)).

The page summary gives M₂=1, but the theorem’s bound |IᵀD²h I|≤M₂|I|∞² requires M₂=2 for h=|I|²/2 in two dimensions. It also uses cosh(σ₀)² where the theorem input is the strip of width s₀, so the norm and physical coupling threshold must use cosh(s₀)².
